copy.tagline: Handpan tones in the rising steam
copy.aboutLead: Healing comes when we immerse ourselves.
copy.aboutBody:
The handpan, an instrument of iron, brings the sound; Kannawa brings the hot springs.
In Kannawa Onsen, connected to iron in name and spirit, handpan culture begins in 2026.
copy.aboutVenueLead: Our venue is a small private rental with a handpan space and a free-flowing natural hot spring:
copy.aboutVenueTail: . Enjoy the hot spring before or after your lesson at no extra charge.
copy.aboutWelcome: Complete beginners are welcome. No equipment needed. Immerse yourself, make music, and meet yourself over five days.
copy.festivalTitle: Spring Celebration: Small Fire Festival Gathering
copy.festivalWhen: Thursday, April 2, 18:00–21:00 · Rooftop of Hachi Beppu The Sky

copy.fullDayCourse: ② All-day lessons & composition for beginner to intermediate players
copy.fullDayPrice: One day / ¥10,000 (handpan use and tea included)
copy.fullDayPoint1: For trial lesson through intermediate level
copy.fullDayPoint2: Focused practice on phrases that lead into composition
copy.fullDayPoint4: Lunch boxes can be arranged on request
copy.buyingBody1:
Each handpan is handmade. Its tone and price vary greatly depending on its scale, material, and maker.
If you are buying your first instrument, we recommend trying one at a workshop first.
copy.buyingBody2:
The Kannawa Onsen Handpan Club workshops also offer advice on buying a handpan.
Reo Matsumoto's videos below may also be helpful.

artists.name: Light
artists.bio: A handpan player known for a delicate, warm tone. As a Kannawa Onsen Handpan Club workshop instructor, Light teaches a wide range of students, from beginners to intermediate players.

artists.name: Seiko
artists.bio: A member of the Kannawa Onsen Handpan Club. Through performances at the Handpan Sound Bath, Seiko brings together hot springs and music.

artists.name: Shun
artists.bio: A handpan player whose distinctive rhythm and expression captivate listeners. Shun has performed live in Kannawa Onsen.

artists.name: Eidon
artists.bio: An artist who specializes in a deep tone and improvisation. Eidon performs at the Handpan Sound Bath in a duo with Seiko.
